title: Case 034: Shower Repair Request
initial_request:
The cold side of the shower isn’t working. Water not coming out. 
Mostly, the warm side is ok but sometimes too hot to pour on body. If cold side is repaired the water could be mixed to equalise temperature. Thanks
overview: The tenant reported that the shower’s cold side was not working and that the warm side could sometimes be too hot. Landlord approval was confirmed and Meadow Works was assigned. The provider reported cleaning and greasing the shower mechanism, resolving the main temperature problem, and sent an invoice. Northbridge Lettings told the landlord the repair was completed on site and a call-out charge applied. The invoice was not uploaded because it was sent to the landlord. The request was closed after checks were completed; the landlord later emailed, “Paid today.”
outcome: The provider cleaned and greased the shower mechanism, resolving the temperature problem. The request was closed after checks were completed.
